prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Although it rained heavily, the match went on.
Although it rained heavily, but the match went on.
Despite it rained heavily, the match went on.
answer: Although it rained heavily, the match went on.

wrong.Although it rained heavily, but the matc: although 已經表示讓步，後面不能再接 but，中文「雖然…但是」在英文只能用一個。
wrong.Despite it rained heavily, the match wen: despite 是介系詞，後面要接名詞或 V-ing，不能直接接完整子句 it rained。

why: although 引導副詞子句，主要子句直接接在逗號後，不需要 but。
tip: although 和 but 不能同時出現在一句。
say: Although it rained heavily, the match went on.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: _____ you finish your homework, you may play video games.
options: As long as
Even though
Unless

wrong.Even though: even though 是「即使」，表示讓步，但這句是在說「完成作業」是玩遊戲的條件。
wrong.Unless: unless 是「除非」，意思會變成「除非你寫完作業，否則可以玩遊戲」，語意前後矛盾。

why: as long as 表示「只要」，說明玩遊戲的條件是寫完作業。
tip: as long as 等於只要，引導條件。
say: As long as you finish your homework, you may play video games.

prompt: 朋友問你為什麼遲到，你想說「因為公車壞了」。哪一句最自然？
options: I was late because the bus broke down.
I was late because of the bus broke down.
Because the bus broke down, so I was late.
answer: I was late because the bus broke down.

wrong.I was late because of the bus broke down: because of 後面要接名詞，不能接完整子句 the bus broke down，應改成 because。
wrong.Because the bus broke down, so I was lat: because 和 so 都表示原因結果，英文只能擇一，不能像中文「因為…所以…」同時用。

why: because 後接完整子句，說明原因，句子簡單自然。
tip: because 接子句，because of 接名詞。
say: I was late because the bus broke down.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Whereas Tom loves spicy food, his sister can't stand it.
options: 湯姆愛吃辣，他妹妹卻受不了
因為湯姆愛吃辣，所以他妹妹受不了
如果湯姆愛吃辣，他妹妹就受不了
answer: 湯姆愛吃辣，他妹妹卻受不了

wrong.因為湯姆愛吃辣，所以他妹妹受不了: whereas 不是表示原因，而是拿兩件事來對比，兩人的口味不同並非因果。
wrong.如果湯姆愛吃辣，他妹妹就受不了: whereas 不是 if，句中也沒有假設的意思，兩人的口味是已經存在的事實。

why: whereas 表示「然而、卻」，用來對比兩個人或兩件事。
say: Whereas Tom loves spicy food, his sister can't stand it.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: _____ the road was icy, Dad drove very slowly.
options: Since
Although
Unless

wrong.Although: although 表示「雖然」，但路面結冰和開得很慢是合理的因果，不是讓步。
wrong.Unless: unless 是「除非」，會變成「除非路面結冰才開很慢」，邏輯不通。

why: 路面結冰是爸爸開慢的原因，since 可表示「既然、因為」。
tip: since 也能表示因為，不只是自從。
say: Since the road was icy, Dad drove very slowly.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Unless you hurry, we'll miss the train.
Unless you don't hurry, we'll miss the train.
Unless you will hurry, we'll miss the train.
answer: Unless you hurry, we'll miss the train.

wrong.Unless you don't hurry, we'll miss the t: unless 本身已經帶有「如果不」的否定意思，再加 don't 會變成雙重否定，語意混亂。
wrong.Unless you will hurry, we'll miss the tr: 表示條件的副詞子句，即使指未來也用現在式，不能在 unless 子句中使用 will。

why: unless = if not，子句用現在式表示未來，且不再加否定。
tip: unless 已含否定，後面別再加 not。
say: Unless you hurry, we'll miss the train.

prompt: 你想說「除非明天下雨，否則我們照常去爬山」。哪一句最適合？
options: We'll go hiking tomorrow unless it rains.
We'll go hiking tomorrow unless it won't rain.
We'll go hiking tomorrow if it rains.
answer: We'll go hiking tomorrow unless it rains.

wrong.We'll go hiking tomorrow unless it won't: unless 子句不可用 will，也不需要 not，這樣寫語法和意思都錯。
if it rains 是「如果下雨就去爬山」，意思剛好顛倒，與「除非下雨」不同。

why: unless it rains 表示只有下雨這個例外才不去，符合題意。
tip: 除非用 unless，後面用現在式。
say: We'll go hiking tomorrow unless it rains.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: He kept smiling _____ he was extremely tired.
options: even though
so that
in case

wrong.so that: so that 表示「為了、以便」，但微笑並不是為了讓他很累，語意不合。
wrong.in case: in case 表示「以防萬一」，與「他其實很累」這個事實無關。

why: 很累卻還在微笑是對比，用 even though 表示「即使」。
tip: even though 後接事實，表示即使。
say: He kept smiling even though he was extremely tired.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Now that the exams are over, we can relax.
options: 既然考試結束了，我們可以放鬆
雖然考試結束了，我們還是不能放鬆
要是考試結束了，我們就可以放鬆
answer: 既然考試結束了，我們可以放鬆

wrong.雖然考試結束了，我們還是不能放鬆: now that 不是讓步，後面也沒有表示「不能」，剛好與原句語氣相反。
wrong.要是考試結束了，我們就可以放鬆: now that 說的是考試已經結束的事實，不是假設；「要是」是 if 的意思。

why: now that 表示「既然、由於現在已經…」，後面說明結果。
tip: now that 是既然，說的是已發生的事。
say: Now that the exams are over, we can relax.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Even though he is rich, he isn't happy.
Even though he is rich, but he isn't happy.
Even he is rich, he isn't happy.
answer: Even though he is rich, he isn't happy.

wrong.Even though he is rich, but he isn't hap: even though 已經表示讓步，主要子句前不能再加 but。
even 單獨使用不能連接兩個子句，要說 even though 或 even if。

why: even though 引導讓步子句，主要子句直接接續。
tip: 讓步連接詞後的主句不加 but。
say: Even though he is rich, he isn't happy.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Bring an umbrella _____ it rains later.
options: in case
although
whereas

wrong.although: although 是「雖然」，會變成「雖然會下雨，還是帶傘」，意思不通順。
wrong.whereas: whereas 用來對比兩件事，這裡並沒有要對比，所以不適合。

why: in case 表示「以防萬一」，帶傘是為了預防下雨。
tip: in case 是以防萬一，要先準備好。
say: Bring an umbrella in case it rains later.

prompt: 你要向老師說「雖然我很累，還是把作業寫完了」。哪一句最好？
options: Though I was very tired, I finished my homework.
Though I was very tired, but I finished my homework.
Because I was very tired, I finished my homework.
answer: Though I was very tired, I finished my homework.

wrong.Though I was very tired, but I finished: though 和 but 重複表示轉折，英文只用其中一個。
wrong.Because I was very tired, I finished my: because 表示原因，會變成「因為很累所以寫完」，與「雖然累」的轉折意思不同。

why: though 表示讓步，說明累卻仍然完成。
tip: 雖然用 though，不要再加 but。
say: Though I was very tired, I finished my homework.
